item.text: {"search_note":"I found good direct evidence on economic bureaucracy and coalition management, plus clear counterevidence on patronage and protest repression. I did not find equally strong direct evidence on APC party machinery or formal military chain-of-command mobilization for the president’s civilian program in 2024. The record is mostly about technocratic economic coordination, executive appointments and reshuffles, protest handling, and one prominent nepotistic appointment. So the evidence base is solid for bureaucratic/coalitional mobilization, weaker for party-machine control, and mixed-to-negative on whether the mobilization was cleanly disciplined or inclusive.","evidence":[{"title":"PECC/EET created to drive coordinated economic execution","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"March 27, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/","summary":"Tinubu created the Presidential Economic Coordination Council and an Emergency Taskforce, explicitly putting the finance minister, CBN governor, key ministers, governors, and private-sector figures into a rapid implementation structure. This is strong evidence that he mobilized bureaucracy and coalition partners toward a defined reform program.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.7"]},{"title":"Public coalition-building after the election","publisher":"The Guardian Nigeria","date":"January 7, 2024","url":"https://guardian.ng/politics/tinubus-call-for-collaboration-on-governance-splits-opposition-parties/","summary":"Tinubu’s New Year message said “Election is over. It’s time for all of us to work together,” signaling a cross-party, post-election coalition posture. Opposition reactions warned it could drift toward one-party dominance, so this is positive on coalition-mobilization but not cleanly democratic in effect.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.1"]},{"title":"Dialogue-first rhetoric during August protests","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu told protesters to suspend demonstrations and “create room for dialogue,” while also urging law enforcement to protect lives and property. This shows some attempt to manage a volatile domestic challenge through coordination and communication, though it was paired with coercive warnings.","question_ids":["8B.3","2B.5"]},{"title":"Central procurement bureaucracy reorganized","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"June 15, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-reorganisation-of-the-bureau-of-public-procurement/","summary":"Tinubu ordered the resignation of the BPP director-general as part of a reorganization to improve efficiency and transparency. This is direct evidence of using executive authority to tighten a core bureaucracy rather than simply leaving it untouched.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.7"]},{"title":"Cabinet reshuffle retained core economic ministries","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"October 23, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigerias-tinubu-names-seven-ministers-sacks-five-in-cabinet-reshuffle/2325625/","summary":"Tinubu reshuffled his cabinet, but retained finance, defence, and national planning while swapping and replacing some other portfolios. That looks more like active executive management than a pure patronage purge or collapse of governing coordination.","question_ids":["8B.3"]},{"title":"Patronage/nepotism counterevidence in a housing agency appointment","publisher":"BusinessDay","date":"February 21, 2024","url":"https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/","summary":"Tinubu appointed his son-in-law to head the Federal Housing Authority, and critics described it as nepotism and a breach of office norms. This is direct counterevidence to a clean technocratic or merit-only reading of how the ruling network was being used.","question_ids":["8B.3","8B.6"]},{"title":"Security forces and coercive readiness undercut restraint","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 31, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462","summary":"Reuters reported that security forces deployed in major cities while the government said it was open to dialogue before protests. This is mixed evidence: the state was mobilizing apparatus and simultaneously offering negotiation, but the coercive posture weakens any claim of purely cooperative mobilization.","question_ids":["8B.3","2B.5"]},{"title":"Protest crackdown and treason framing show punitive state mobilization","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"September 2, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Prosecutors charged protesters with treason and alleged destabilization and mutiny. That suggests the state’s coercive machinery was used to intimidate dissent, which cuts against an interpretation of effective, disciplined mobilization toward broadly constructive goals.","question_ids":["8B.3","2B.5","4B.4"]}]}
